x1.reason: Cancelling a reset releases its runner lock while an in-flight thread can still delete data, and a Postgres disconnect can drop the session lock mid-reset. Needs a cancel mid-reset plus a second reset at once; the data is demo data reseeded nightly. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x1.fix: Shield the reset's worker threads from cancellation (await them before releasing), and check the session lock is still held before each destructive step.

x2.reason: Eviction still resets a document's run budget at the 10,000 cap. Decided best effort on 2026-11-20 on the advisor's evidence: a beta document can spend at most about $0.07 against a $2 run cap, a worker restart already resets it, and the daily ledger is the hard bound; documented in runtime.py and operations.md. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x2.fix: Keep per-document spend in Postgres if a hard per-document guarantee is ever wanted.

x3.reason: A refund the database cannot write is logged and the amount stays counted until the UTC day ends. Fails closed: no request is sent. Needs Postgres down through both the switch read and the refund. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x3.fix: Queue the failed refund and replay it when Postgres returns, or reconcile from the reservation rows.

x4.reason: The load run cannot tell a sample that completed from one that failed when the reset deleted it first, and review-action errors do not fail the run. Load harness only; nothing in production runs it. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x4.fix: Check each sample's outcome before the reset, and count review-action errors as problems.

x5.reason: The load run's stub-call check counts the harness's own probe, so it cannot fail. Load harness only; the worker's base URL is checked separately and the daily ledger bounds spend. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x5.fix: Count stub calls from before the first sample and require calls from workflows.

x6.reason: The load run's stats check omits the one-off container that does the measured reset. Load harness only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x6.fix: Require stats for the hand-run reset container as well.

x7.reason: The reset service writes its ready file before the startup reset, so compose --wait can finish while samples still answer 503 resetting. Cosmetic: the page says resetting and the reset finishes in under two minutes. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x7.fix: Write the ready file after the startup catch-up, or have the runbook wait for healthz resetting false.

x8.reason: A visitor who approves a seed document during the reset makes the 12-held check fail, and the retry deletes that action. Needs a review click in the minute the reset runs at 08:00 UTC; demo data only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x8.fix: Count filed and dismissed seeds as settled in the 12 check, or hide seeds from the queue until the flag clears.

x9.reason: If Postgres is down before the reset writes its flag, the fallback write fails too, and health can show the prior success; the scheduler's record read sits outside its retry. Needs a database outage at 08:00. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x9.fix: Wrap the scheduler's record read in the retry, and treat a failed flag write as a failed reset that retries.

x10.reason: The load run and the compose check read the env file without stripping quotes, so a quoted key skips the real-key check and quoted codes make bad cookies. Operator tooling; the example file uses unquoted values. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x10.fix: Parse the env file with compose's own rules (python-dotenv) in both scripts.

x11.reason: The load run's up-failure path prints compose stderr, which can quote an env value. Filed with f8 and s1, the same class. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x11.fix: Print only the failing setting's name, never compose's raw stderr.

x12.reason: The load run ignores the exit codes of its down -v calls, and an interruption during up skips cleanup. Load harness only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x12.fix: Check both down exit codes and start the try before up.

x13.reason: The runbook's volume backup loop can exit zero after a failed archive. The pg_dump part is fixed. Operator runbook; the deploy will run each backup and check its output by hand. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x13.fix: Fail the loop on any archive error (set -e inside, or track a status).

x14.reason: The runbook hardcodes port 8001, while compose lets the operator choose DOCKET_PORT. The deploy uses 8001. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x14.fix: Use ${DOCKET_PORT:-8001} in the runbook's checks and Caddy block, or drop the setting.

x15.reason: ADR-009 says the nightly reset removes Temporal history; it does not, and Temporal keeps closed runs for the namespace retention. Docs only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x15.fix: Correct ADR-009 and state the retention the dev server uses.

x16.reason: ADR-009 quotes load-run figures that no tracked output backs. Docs only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x16.fix: Commit the load run's JSON output beside the ADR.

x17.reason: A Dockerfile comment says the index digest gives both platforms the same layers. Comment only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x17.fix: Say it pins the base per platform.

x18.reason: A Dockerfile comment implies the API writes a ready file. Comment only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
x18.fix: Name the worker and the reset as the services with ready files.

x19.reason: The example env says any blank value stops compose; a blank DOCKET_PORT falls back to 8001. Comment only. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.

x20.reason: Two secret-scan pragmas on dummy key fixtures, each limited to its line. Informational. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.

x21.reason: The compose check and the load run parse the env file without stripping quotes, so a value comparison can fail open. Same cause as x10. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.

x22.reason: The load run's stub-call proof counts its own probe. Same cause as x5. Tracked in builds/beta/plan.md, PR D carry-ins.
